notes.title: Beebo& Luna v1.0.3 Update Announcement
notes.content: [p]Dear Dreamcatcher,[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]To enhance your gaming experience, we’ve released a new update for [i]Beebo&Luna[/i]. Below are the key improvements:[/p][olist][*][p]Fixed character image display issues in the storyline.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved the issue where save file conflicts prevented unlocking of theme content and guests (excluding the "Fantasy Worlds" theme).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Beebo’s mouse cursor tracking problem.[/p][/*][*][p]Repaired certain decoration animations for Beebo.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized game performance and fixed multiple bugs.[/p][/*][/olist][p align="start"]We hope Beebo will always accompany you, bringing joy to your days![/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Best regards,[/p][p]Dorimora Studio[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45591683/0d8670d78a805c0f3d4ab21e8c6715a673a1b148.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Beebo & Luna is officially OUT Now
notes.content: [h2]Beebo & Luna is now officially launched! [/h2][p][/p][p]Available for both Windows and Mac, featuring brand-new decorations, a fully developed bonding system, more charming guests, heartwarming storylines, and enhanced features—all content unlocked instantly. [/p][p][/p][p]May Beebo help you balance productivity and calm, sharing every cozy, joyful moment with you.[/p][p][/p][p]Join our Discord server([url="https://discord.gg/86dqnp8Vb6"]https://discord.gg/86dqnp8Vb6[/url])! Chat with the developers and connect with fellow players who share your passion for the game![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45591683/0d8670d78a805c0f3d4ab21e8c6715a673a1b148.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Beebo& Luna Demo v0.1.7 Update Announcement
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone, to create a better dream-catching environment, we've released some new content and made a few adjustments![/p][p]Here's what's new in this update:[/p][list][*][p][b]New Player Tutorial:[/b] We've added a comprehensive tutorial module to help new players get started and understand the game mechanics more easily.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Beebo Desktop Interactions:[/b] Look forward to brand-new interactive animations for Beebo when Beebo on your desktop![/p][/*][*][p][b]Smoother Dressing Room Camera Transitions:[/b] Moving the camera in the dressing room is now much more fluid.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Story BGM:[/b] We've added several background music tracks that play during story segments.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b] We've addressed multiple bugs to improve overall game stability and performance.[/p][/*][/list][p]If you encounter any issues or have feedback, please don't hesitate to reach out for help in our Discord group. We're always happy to assist![/p][p]
[b]Click to join us: [url="https://discord.gg/fyJheuBa"]https://discord.gg/fyJheuBa[/url][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45591683/aebc2466196ed2d73e203c1211874e84fa4f2094.png"][/img][/p]
